home.emptyInstalled: Nothing installed yet. Open the library to add a program.
home.welcome: A store for programs that stay themselves.
home.welcomeBody: Developers write in the language they already know. You install from GitHub, with a contract no thicker than a manifest.
home.popularBody: Top starred and most forked programs slide by on their own. Everything else sits below, ready to sort and filter.
home.emptyCatalog: No programs match these filters yet.

discover.title: Discover
discover.subtitle: Public GitHub repositories tagged muck-store.
discover.empty: No repositories found. Publish with topic muck-store, or paste a repo URL.

trust.title: Approve this program
trust.body: Muck Store checked the GitHub source, license, manifest and hashes. It does not audit the author's intent. Community programs can still harm this PC — approve only if you trust this repository.
trust.verifiedBody: This program is in the official catalog. Muck Store verified its manifest, license and bundled files. Authenticode / SmartScreen is not required.
trust.blockedHint: Verification failed. This program will not be installed.
trust.av: Windows Defender may still scan the files. Muck Store does not turn Defender off. After you approve, the download mark is cleared so SmartScreen is not the install prompt — our checklist is.

updates.title: Updates
updates.subtitle: Catalog programs update here. The store itself updates in a small window before it opens.

themes.title: Themes
themes.subtitle: Click a card to apply it. Edit custom themes in the studio with the pencil; programs keep their own UI.
themes.emptyImported: No custom themes yet. Create one, or import a theme.json.
themes.systemHint: Matches Windows light, dark, high contrast, and accent color.
themes.deleteConfirm: Delete this custom theme? This cannot be undone.
themes.studioPreviewHint: Click a region in the preview; only that surface changes.
themes.studioPickHint: Cards, nav, title bar and buttons are separate tokens. Painting one does not drag the others.
themes.studioCardHint: Card summaries use this muted text color.

groupHint.window: The store canvas. Title bar and sidebar are separate.
groupHint.titlebar: The top chrome, brand word, and window caption. Does not paint the sidebar.
groupHint.sidebar: The side panel ground. Menu items are painted on their own.
groupHint.nav: Idle, hover, and selected menu. Independent from the primary button.
groupHint.cards: Home program cards. Library rows are separate.
groupHint.panels: Settings fields, menus, and leftover panels.

tokenHint.bg: The window and main canvas. Solid or a gradient.
tokenHint.bgElevated: Settings, menus, and leftover panels. Does not paint the title bar.
tokenHint.surface: Program cards only. Solid or a gradient.
tokenHint.surfaceHover: What a card looks like on hover.
tokenHint.border: Default line on leftover panels. Cards and rows have their own.
tokenHint.borderStrong: The thicker line on focus and hover.
tokenHint.textMuted: Card summaries, hints, and secondary copy.
tokenHint.accent: Primary buttons like Run. Does not paint the menu.
tokenHint.accentText: Text sitting on the primary button.
tokenHint.radiusSm: Corners on pills and small chips.
tokenHint.blur: Glass blur when mica is on.
tokenHint.titlebarBg: The top chrome. Independent from the sidebar. Solid or a gradient.
tokenHint.titlebarBorder: The line under the title bar.
tokenHint.titlebarText: STORE and the window caption buttons.
tokenHint.brand: The MUCK word. Independent from the primary button.
tokenHint.sidebarBg: The side panel ground. Independent from the title bar.
tokenHint.navActiveBg: Selected menu fill. Independent from the primary button.
tokenHint.navActiveBar: The inset bar on the selected item.
tokenHint.buttonBg: Secondary buttons like Cancel. Not the card fill.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Layout, startup, trust and the paths Muck Store uses on this PC.
settings.appearanceHint: Layout and motion for the store window.
settings.languageHint: Follows your Windows display language, or pick one from the list.
settings.themeHint: System follows Windows light, dark, high contrast, and accent color.
settings.micaHint: Soft blur on chrome. Turn off if you prefer a solid panel.
settings.reducedMotionHint: Cuts transitions if they feel noisy.
settings.fontScaleHint: Scales the store interface, not installed programs.
settings.libraryHint: Programs, cache and themes live outside the install folder.
settings.updatesHint: The store and installed programs share this check. New catalog items are listed for information only.
settings.autoStoreHint: Automatic applies at launch through the updater. In-session store updates wait in the titlebar so this window is not closed.
settings.autoProgramsHint: Automatic installs in the background. Startup applies when the store opens. Manual only runs when you check.
settings.telemetryOff: Off by default and staying off unless you enable it.
settings.approvalsHint: Programs you approved after verification. A new version or commit needs a fresh approval. No code-signing certificate is required.
settings.defender: Add Defender exclusion for the programs folder
settings.defenderHint: Never applied silently. Requires your consent and a UAC prompt.
settings.isolation: Job Object isolation for started programs
settings.isolationHint: Recorded for a later Windows Job Object pass. Starting a program no longer freezes the store.

programSettings.title: Program settings
programSettings.lockHint: Locked programs are skipped during update checks.
programSettings.versionHint: Install a GitHub release. Locking pins the selected tag.
programSettings.argsHint: Passed to the program on start, for example -test.
programSettings.enabledHint: Disabled programs stay installed but do not start.
programSettings.autostartDenied: This program did not declare the autostart permission.

boot.hint: Catalog and settings load from this PC. Store updates run in the updater before this window opens.
